title: dnd-5e-2024 encounter stats (docs/rulesets.md#encounters)
description: An arrangement (docs/content-model.md#arrangements): kit parts in page order, and the map it's set in. Its one roster or spawn table, a spawn table's ranges, dice counts, and a table part's table, and E are checks in encounters.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks).

parts.description: The kit parts, in the order the page renders them. Exactly one is a roster or a spawn table.

setIn.description: The map the encounter is set in, or a zone of it. The map's page lists the encounter there; a map part shows the map on this page.

environment.description: E, the environment multiplier on the encounter's XP, and why. Without it, E is 1; a multiplier of 1 is an error and any other a review warning, checks in encounters.ts.

note.description: Why the setting makes it harder or easier, such as "difficult terrain and a collapsing floor".

Part.description: One kit part, by its `part`. An encounter allows every kit part but a module's own, `hook` and `arrangement`.
